subject: english
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.

Enthusiasm is one of those vital elements that transforms an indivdual and his failures into victories and success.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Indivdual".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Indivdual"** is spelled incorrectly. It is a misspelling of the word **"Individual"**.
 
• **English meaning:** The word "Individual" refers to a single human being, distinct from a group. (व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** Each individual has their own unique talents and abilities.
 
 
 
• **Correct word:** "Individual" (व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The rights of every individual must be protected.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Success** (सफलता): The accomplishment of an aim or purpose.

 
 
• **Example:** Hard work and determination are key to achieving success in life.
 
 
 
• **Victories** (जीत): Acts of defeating an opponent or overcoming challenges.
 
 
• **Example:** The team celebrated their back-to-back victories in the tournament.
 
 
 
• **Failures** (असफलता): Lack of success in achieving a goal or objective.
 
 
• **Example:** Failures should be seen as learning opportunities for future success.
